name: Spellfire Robes
summary: Spellfire Robes is the culminating rite in the training of young Horde mages in the Undercity, completed by the tailor Josef Gregorian. After gathering rare components from across the realm, the apprentice is rewarded with custom enchanted vestments that signify their growing mastery over the arcane.

sections.title: A Mage's Vestment
sections.body: For apprentices mastering the arcane arts in Lordaeron, standard cloaks and common garments do little to channel or insulate against raw eldritch forces. Josef Gregorian, a tailor working in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, weaves genuine magical garb from the specialized materials promising Horde spellcasters gather. The final stitching of the Spellfire Robes represents an apprentice's transition beyond basic incantations into an established practitioner of arcane and fire arts.

sections.title: Woven Power
sections.body: Crafting garments capable of safely focusing high-intensity magic is an exacting task. Rather than mere tailoring, the creation of robes such as these requires specific alchemical and arcane components secured through dangerous trials. Once these supplies are gathered and presented in Gregorian's sanctum, the tailor weaves them together on the spot, bestowing a tangible mark of status and protection upon the aspiring mage.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Spellfire Robes quest?
faq.answer: It serves as the final step in an early class rite for Horde mages, rewarding them with specially enchanted robes after they have gathered tailoring components for the tailor Josef Gregorian.
Josef Gregorian is a Forsaken tailor working in the Magic Quarter's tailor shop in the Undercity. He stitches the first proper class garments for newly minted mages sent to him by Anastasia Hartwell.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
aliases: where to turn in spellfire robes
faq.answer: The entire interaction takes place within the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, directly at Josef Gregorian's tailor shop.

faq.q: Why don't you have to leave to do another task for this quest?
faq.answer: All the labor was completed in the preceding assignment, Gathering Materials. Once you hand those reagents to Josef, he simply takes a moment to weave the garment and immediately hands over the finished robes.

faq.q: Can classes other than Mages obtain these robes?
faq.answer: No. The entire quest chain and the resulting enchanted vestments are exclusive to mages allied with the Horde.

faq.q: What materials were required to make these robes?
faq.answer: The robe is constructed from the rare supplies collected during the previous task, which include linen cloth and Dalaran mana gems taken from the Kirin Tor mages of Silverpine Forest.

angles.text: Obtaining these robes is an early rite of passage for Horde practitioners, providing tailored attire capable of handling volatile fire and arcane energies.
Forsaken spellcasters in the Undercity preserve Dalaran-style arcane discipline, combining old magical traditions with their new existence in Lordaeron's ruins.
The quest demonstrates how mundane cloth is augmented with exotic reagents to withstand and enhance powerful magical currents.
